messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — product asked for a per-route ‘correlation ledger’ in Console: ability to link a request id -> trace/span + route+model so they can debug cost+latency regressions across Dedicated/private tiers. Can we map out what runtime/infra needs to provide?
Sam: +1. We need a stable request id header propagated from edge through runtime, and a trace id that ties to our internal span tree. Current runtime injects trace_id for spans but request_id is generated at the proxy sometimes.
Ana: From observability side we need: request_id, trace_id, parent_span_id, route, model_variant, quantization_profile, and a sampling tag. Also whether KV cache hit/miss is on the request path. That lets dashboards correlate cost vs latency.
Mike: Implementation constraints: we can add x-redwood-request-id at the proxy layer. Runtime will need to plumb it to the executor and ensure it's included in logs/traces. Concern: we currently truncate headers in some internal hop — must audit.
Jules: Question: do we use request_id == trace_id? pros/cons?
Sam: I prefer separate ids. trace_id is for span baggage and may be re-used across retries; request_id is a higher-level request correlation. Simpler to keep both.
Ana: Agreed. UI wants to show the request lifecycle: request_id -> top-level trace -> span list. If trace_id==request_id we lose distinction for multi-span requests.
Elaine: For sampling, product wants full traces for errors and a small % of successes. Proposal: errors = 100% trace; successes = 0.5% by default (configurable per-customer/route). Thoughts?
Mike: Sounds reasonable. We'll need a sampling policy evaluator in the ingress/edge to mark samples early so downstream services know not to drop spans. Could add a header: x-rw-trace-sampled: 1/0 and x-rw-sample-reason: error|probabilistic|manual.
Sam: Runtime: need to honor header, and when sampled=1, keep full KV cache debug metadata (but redact tokens). Also attach route/model tags to spans.
Ana: For dashboards, we'll consume the trace events and logs into Clickhouse/trace-views. Requirements from infra: trace events must include the same request_id field as logs/metrics for a join key. Also include a compact tag set: [route, model, quant, cache_hit].
Jules: Security note: request_id must not carry PII. Make sure no user-provided string becomes request_id. Always generate server-side or canonicalize/validate.
Elaine: Good call. Enforce UUIDv4 at edge and drop any incoming request-id header unless it matches our UUID pattern (except for internal partner headers).
Sam: Work items I see: 1) edge: canonical request id generator + sample decision headers, 2) runtime: propagate and attach tags to spans/logs, 3) infra: ingestion pipeline update to index request_id and tag fields, 4) console: UI to query by request_id and show trace + per-token cost.
Mike: On backlog — I'll add an audit ticket for header truncation and a perf test for extra header propagation. We should measure added bytes and p95 tail.
Ana: One more: sampling config api for product teams. Need per-route overrides, and a rollout UX (canary % ramp). Console needs a simple slider that writes a route-level sampling policy.
Elaine: @Ana @Mike can you draft the minimal schema for the ingestion side? e.g., {request_id, trace_id, span_id, route, model, quant_profile, cache_hit, sampled, sample_reason, ts, duration_ms, token_count}. Keep fields snake_case. We will validate against that.
Ana: I'll put a proposal in docs and link to this thread. Will include retention implications (full traces cost a lot).
Sam: Small code snippet for header expectations (to avoid ambiguity):
```
# edge adds
X-Redwood-Request-Id: <uuid4>
X-Redwood-Trace-Sampled: 1|0
X-Redwood-Sample-Reason: error|probabilistic|manual
```
Runtime should also add span tags: `rw.route`, `rw.model`, `rw.quant`, `rw.cache_hit`.
Mike: I'll also add deploy-bot hooks so when a sampling policy changes we create an audit log event in the infra channel.
deploy-bot: NOTE: sampling-policy change will be logged to infra/audit when rule is applied.
Jules: Let's also think about correlating retries: include `rw.retry_count` tag so console can collapse repeated attempts.
Elaine: Nice. Next steps: Mike -> header audit ticket by EOD, Sam -> runtime PR for propagation + tagging, Ana -> ingestion schema + cost estimate, Jules -> add retry_count in span contract. I'll check in tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
